heading: ### The service's limits — what tameshi refuses to mutation-test

findings.why: Row b's two this-page anchors do not resolve at 9cf0146b. At C0, SKILL.md 824-828 is the mado pin/pristine paragraph (`sha256 d7edaab4…`, `45334 B, 1098 newlines`, ending `A moved substrate needs a re-pin, never a re-interpretation of the old table.`) — row c's evidence, not row b's; the one-command-hermetic-suite clause row b cites is at 828-832 (`2. **A one-command hermetic suite** invocable against a copy — mado's gate takes bash "$MUTANT" --selftest`). At C0, 851-855 is a fence close plus `1. **Pin + pristine.**` and the head of `2. **Spec parse + uniqueness.**`; the cited `MUTATE: SETUP (<reason>)`, exit 2 — no headline is at 855-857 (verbatim on line 857). Both anchors were exact at base 0a2010ac (824 = `2. **A one-command hermetic suite**`, 851 = `2. **Spec parse + uniqueness.**`); C0 itself moved them: the round-55 Standing-rules edit `@@ -35,7 +35,11 @@` is +7/-3 = +4 lines above line 824, so every later this-page anchor inherited a +4 offset. Net effect at C0: a reader following row b lands on the pin/sha evidence for row c and on the spec-parse head without its verdict line.

Row c's anchor is stale by the same +4. At C0, 834-836 reads `3. **A clause-mapped defect spec** — one single-edit defect per declared contract clause … F reader fallback`, while the sentence the row cites (`4. Nothing else. The service never edits, repairs or re-pins the gate; a needed change is a recommendation to the owner`) is at 838-840. Exact at base 0a2010ac (838-4 = 834), so the offset is introduced by C0, not inherited from round 9.

Row f's anchor is stale by the same +4. At C0, 890-892 is the `**The harness itself is pinned per run.**` bullet (re-pin `b56c6e57…`), while the cited `**Sensitivity, not truth** — a sweep measures what the suite can detect, never whether the gate's verdicts are right` bullet is at 894-896. Exact at base 0a2010ac (890).

The claim the range supports is true but the range is base-relative. Verified at C0: `git show <C0>:SKILL.md | sed -n '1023,1169p' | grep -n service-limits` returns no match, and `grep -n service-limits` over fleet-kill-rate-ledger.md at C0 returns nothing either, so `no cadence or ledger text names it` holds for both cited files (10/10 external anchors below resolve). But the range itself resolves 4 lines early: C0 line 1023 is inside the preceding section (`mismatch / unresolvable revision as SETUP, and a single flipped entry failing loudly`), the round-8 section it is meant to span starts at 1027 (`## The re-sweep cadence and the six-case confidence statement (round 8, measured)`) and ends at 1173, with the next heading at 1174. So the cited window at C0 covers four lines of the wrong section and drops the last four lines of the intended one.
